obligation: N051 — SENSITIVITY_ALLOCATION (S026 §26, §3; DOC-REPRESENTATION; CPU). Value of information per organ / layer / channel via an activation-aware second-order proxy (diagonal Fisher / activation-weighted magnitude on real activations, streamed). Classify disposable/cheap/ordinary/sensitive/critical. Produce the marginal capability-gain-per-bit curve N041 consumes to move below uniform per-organ floors, refining the 2.5969 complete-EBPW allocation. Sensitivity is a proxy: it ranks, it does not certify.

proxy.name: diagonal_fisher_activation_weighted_magnitude
proxy.formula: VoI_ij = 0.5 * E_t[x_{t j}^2] * W_{ij}^2 ; capability_VoI = VoI * q_mult(layer)
proxy.fisher: For Y=XW^T under a locally-quadratic (MSE / Gaussian) model, the Hessian/Fisher diagonal on W_ij is E[x_j^2].

nulls.gaussian_isotropic_X: E[x_j^2] constant in j; ranking collapses to |W|. Real d_participation << 1 is evidence the capture is not that null.
nulls.weight_only: 0.5 mean(d) ||W||_F^2. Spearman vs activation-aware is reported; disagreement is the value of the activation term.
nulls.cosine_scale_trap: 0.01*W scores cosine 1.0; this VoI scores 1e-4 of identity.

capture.source_note: workspace/campaign/phaseB/capture_diverse2 via /Users/scammermike/Downloads/hawking-copy/workspace/campaign/phaseB/capture_diverse2: post_attn_norm, 11269 real tokens, BF16 parent MLX full-model forward. Not Gaussian. Mixer in_proj uses this site as a PROXY (true site is input_layernorm). down_proj / out_proj activations are reconstructed on a 256-token fit subsample from streamed parent weights. lm_head uses last-layer post_attn as a PROXY for final hidden. embed uses reconstructed capture token frequencies. No second 27B decode.

token_prior.note: token frequencies from capture_diverse2 reconstructed prompt ids (HARDCODED_FAMILIES + parent tokenizer.json). Laplace +1. Unseen rows are LOCKED at the N041 embed floor (S026 §109: the capture long tail is not evidence of disposable information). This is the capture distribution, not the pretraining distribution.

scale_trap.note: VoI is second-order in W, so 0.01*W has 1e-4 the VoI. Cosine would score 1.0 on 0.01*W; this proxy does not.

class_cuts.on: per-organ rank cuts on depth-weighted VoI/param of unlocked channels; global values below are GEMV-only (embed excluded so the vocab tail cannot dominate percentiles). Embed unseen rows are locked (S026 §109).
